newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Air Malta Brussels flights in demand for jeans.
newsitem.headline: Air Malta Brussels flights in demand for jeans.

text.p: Air Malta's freighter flights to Brussels are fully-loaded with jeans destined for mainland Europe, said John van Rijn, owner of Aero Freight International, the carrier's general sales agent.

Demand for the Malta manufactured jeans enabled the carrier to double its freighter flights to Brussels to twice-weekly from October 17, This frequency will continue to December 19 and probably start again in the beginning of January, after the factory closure period in Malta.
The service flies from Brussels each Thursday and Sunday with either a Boeing 727-200 or 727-100 full freighter.
Aero Freight International represents 12 airlines including Delta Air Lines, LOT, Croatia Airlines and CSA. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
